title: Ordinary and ringed cochain pullbacks with their unit and derived computation maps
statement: For prime l, finite E/Q_l and every scheme morphism f:X→Y, there exists a natural isomorphism b from the ringed cochain pullback OpenFactorCoherence.pullCx [def-sf-pull-completion-comparison] to ordinaryIntegralPullComplex [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback]. Its inverse sends each ordinary adjunction-unit section in degree i to the corresponding ringed adjunction-unit section. For every complex P, pullIso(QP) followed by the ordinary computation counit equals the ringed derived computation map followed by Q(b(P)). This is an identification of cochain pullback models and their computation maps; it does not involve a completion tower or a tensor input.

proof.text: Use the constructed module pullback isomorphism and its proved inverse-unit section formula.

Apply that isomorphism degreewise. Naturality across the cochain-to-homotopy quotient, and uniqueness of total left derived functors, identify the universal computation maps. Cancel the quotient comparison isomorphisms.
Apply the inverse module isomorphism to the unit identity and cancel its composite with the hom. This gives the required inverse-unit formula; package it with the derived computation formula.

theorem pullbackComplexIdentification {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ b : OpenFactorCoherence.pullCx l E f ≅ ordinaryIntegralPullComplex l E f,
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (i : ℤ)
        (V : Y.ProEt) (x : (P.X i).val.obj (op V)),
        (((b.inv.app P).f i).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V)))
          ((((ordinaryIntegralModuleAdjunction l E f).unit.app (P.X i)).val.app (op V)) x) =
        (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction f ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
          ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X)
          ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f)).unit.app (P.X i)).val.app (op V)) x) ∧
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ,
        (pullIso l E f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
            ordinaryIntegralPullComplexCounit l E f P =
          (proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors f ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f)).hom.app P ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (b.hom.app P))
